description_en: In the scenario where Employee B sends an SMS to Customer A through work number X, Employee B uses the client to send an SMS to Customer A. The client must call this API to obtain an "SMS sending tag" and append the "tag" to the end of the SMS content. The work number platform parses the real called number A through the "tag" and sends the SMS to number A
description_zh: 员工B通过工作号X向客户A下发短信场景中，员工B使用客户端向客户A 发送短信，客户端须通过本接口获取“短信下发标签”，并在短信内容尾部中添加该“标签”。工作号平台通过“标签”解析出真实被叫A号码，下发短信到A号码
name: CreateSmsSign
